statement: 300 accuracy gives 5% hit chance on Dr. Defecaus; 900 accuracy hits him 100% of the time

statement: You need 1223 Defense to ignore all his damage which is mostly not possible at this time

statement: Bring plenty of food when fighting Dr. Defecaus
